description: This file implements REST API endpoints for managing Resident entities within a Resident Directory Management System. It includes routes for listing, exporting, importing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting residents. The code uses FastAPI for the web framework, SQLAlchemy for database interactions, and Pydantic schemas for data validation. It supports complex filtering, searching, CSV import/export with upsert logic, and admin authentication dependencies.

methods.description: Normalizes CSV row values by trimming and handling nulls.
